If no capturing move is available, it selects a safe move that prevents the opponent from immediately capturing a box on their next turn (since if they capture, they get another turn and might score points in a chain). This approach is greedy but effective for a small grid like 4x4, as it minimizes damage from the opponent and maximizes immediate gains. It is not a full minimax due to time constraints (1 second limit), but it performs well against weaker strategies.
